name: Question 15
problem: Find the total area of the region bounded by the graph of the curve $y=\frac{3}{16+{x}^{2}}$ and the $x$-axis.
worked_solution:
We find the area of the region bounded by the graph of the curve and the $x$-axis by calculating the integral

$$
A={\int }_{-\infty }^{\infty }\frac{3}{16+{x}^{2}}\,\text{d}x.
$$

We break up the integral as follows:

$$
{\int }_{-\infty }^{\infty }\frac{3}{16+{x}^{2}}\,\text{d}x={\int }_{-\infty }^{0}\frac{3}{16+{x}^{2}}\,\text{d}x+{\int }_{0}^{\infty }\frac{3}{16+{x}^{2}}\,\text{d}x.
$$

Evaluating the first of these integrals, we get

$$
\begin{aligned}{\int }_{-\infty }^{0}\frac{3}{16+{x}^{2}}\,\text{d}x & ={lim}_{a\to -\infty }{\int }_{a}^{0}\frac{3}{16+{x}^{2}}\,\text{d}x \\  & =3{lim}_{a\to -\infty }{\int }_{a}^{0}\frac{1}{{x}^{2}+{4}^{2}}\,\text{d}x \\  & =3{lim}_{a\to -\infty }(\frac{1}{4}\operatorname{arctan}⁡\frac{x}{4}){|}_{a}^{0} \\  & =\frac{3}{4}{lim}_{a\to -\infty }(\operatorname{arctan}⁡0-\operatorname{arctan}⁡\frac{a}{4}) \\  & =\frac{3}{4}(0-(-\frac{\pi }{2})) \\  & =\frac{3\pi }{8}.\end{aligned}
$$

Now, notice that the integrand is an **even** function. This means that we can immediately deduce that 

$$
{\int }_{0}^{\infty }\frac{3}{16+{x}^{2}}\,\text{d}x=\frac{3\pi }{8}.
$$

Therefore, since both improper integrals exist, we conclude that 

$$
\begin{aligned}{\int }_{-\infty }^{\infty }\frac{3}{16+{x}^{2}}\,\text{d}x & ={\int }_{-\infty }^{0}\frac{3}{16+{x}^{2}}\,\text{d}x+{\int }_{0}^{\infty }\frac{3}{16+{x}^{2}}\,\text{d}x \\  & =\frac{3\pi }{8}+\frac{3\pi }{8} \\  & =\frac{3\pi }{4}.\end{aligned}
$$

EXPLANATION

We find the area of the region bounded by the graph of the curve and the x-axis by calculating the integral A=∫−∞∞316+x2dx.

We break up the integral as follows:

∫−∞∞316+x2dx=∫−∞0316+x2dx+∫0∞316+x2dx.

Evaluating the first of these integrals, we get

∫−∞0316+x2dx=lima→−∞∫a0316+x2dx=3lima→−∞∫a01x2+42dx=3lima→−∞(14arctan⁡x4)|a0=34lima→−∞(arctan⁡0−arctan⁡a4)=34(0−(−π2))=3π8.

Now, notice that the integrand is an even function. This means that we can immediately deduce that

∫0∞316+x2dx=3π8.

Therefore, since both improper integrals exist, we conclude that ∫−∞∞316+x2dx=∫−∞0316+x2dx+∫0∞316+x2dx=3π8+3π8=3π4.
